targetText:
The same quantity, 1 shilling or 2 hours,
is added in one case and subtracted in the other.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Changes of Magnitude in the Price of Labour-Power and in Surplus-Value: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
The price of labour-power and
the degree of its exploitation cease to be commensurable quantities.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
